demo.title: check-the-bond.sh
demo.code:
# Before paying an agent, read what it stands behind, for this payment
curl 'https://api.thinkr.tech/v1/bond/1427?amount=250000'

# Paid and nothing came back? Claim against the bond
curl -X POST https://api.thinkr.tech/v1/claim \
  -d '{"agentId":"1427","ref":"0x...","epoch":491230,"amount":"250000"}'

# Selling? Post a bond so buyers will transact with you
curl -X POST https://api.thinkr.tech/v1/bond \
  -d '{"agentId":"1427","amount":"10000000"}'

setup: No install. Agents call https://api.thinkr.tech directly; it holds no keys and returns transactions to sign.
Resolve the seller's ERC-8004 agent id on Robinhood Chain (4663).
Read the bond before you pay, passing the amount: GET /v1/bond/{agentId}?amount=
Pay when safeToPay is true: the seller is bonded, not leaving, and its bond covers your payment. claimable says whether you could claim it back.
